decisions.reason: The thermal inkjet printer sits close to the core coding business and generates recurring consumables revenue, so keeping it costs little while its prospects keep resolving, especially after the piezo variant was dropped.
As the flagship laser marking line featured on the home page and central to the firm's Industry 4.0 direction, it is a strategic option worth further commitment rather than abandonment.

The newly launched compact laser cabin complements the flagship laser line at low incremental cost, and its value is still uncertain, so the option stays open even though the earlier manual laser workstation was withdrawn.
The award-winning lubricant printing system opens a specialized sheet metal niche with positive early signals, so keeping this low-cost option open is justified until market uptake becomes clearer.
